entities.name: Vilém Holáň
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vilém Holáň was a Czech politician who served as Minister of Defense for KDU-ČSL from 1994 to 1996, during which he favored Czech accession to NATO. He was an observer to the European Parliament in 2003 and 2004. Holáň was born in Ostrava.

entities.summary: Vilém Holáň was a Czech politician who served as Minister of Defense for KDU-ČSL from 1994 to 1996, during which he favored Czech accession to NATO. He was an observer to the European Parliament in 2003 and 2004. Holáň was born in Ostrava.
